# Felinids
Small and mischievous cat-eared people. Being small has plenty of upsides and downsides.
## Diet
- Can eat raw meat, and will happily eat mice and rats whole.
## Benefits
- They are smaller than Humans, making them harder to hit. - Have the ability to cough up a hairball to purge some of the chemicals from their bloodstream. - Eating a whole mouse or rat feeds them and refreshes the hairball ability. - Use their claws to deal Slashing and Piercing damage.
## Drawbacks
- Take 15% more Blunt, Slash and Piercing damage. - Slow down more sharply as they take damage.
